The group

Two companies, split by who they serve

Maitri Overseas is the mother company. The work is divided so each kind of customer gets the attention it needs, rather than everything running through one desk.

Mother company

Maitri Overseas

OEM and end-customer requirements — automotive, kitchen equipment, dairy and elevators. Cut-to-size, polished and slit material supplied to the customer's own drawing.

Group company

Rajsheelam Exports

Importing, exporting and stockholding. Grades and widths that aren't rolled locally are landed and held here, so buyers order off an Indian stock list.

What that gets you

  • Just-in-time delivery to your door
  • Big coils broken into small lots
  • Inventory held on your behalf
  • Warehousing and stock management

What we supply

Stainless steel, in the form your line needs

Slit, cut-to-size, polished and blanked to processing tolerances, then despatched with mill test certificates.

S.S. welded pipes

Made on our own ERW tube mill, 1″ to 4″ in 0.6 – 2.0 mm wall.

Sheets & plates

Cut to length up to 3000 mm, sheared and polished to finish.

Coils & slit coils

Slit to width from 0.5 – 2.5 mm stock, re-coiled to your handling weight.

Round bars

Bright and black bar for machining, fasteners and shafting.

Circles & blanks

Blanked on a zig-zag stamping machine, so nesting is tight and you buy metal rather than scrap. For utensils, pressure parts and deep-drawn components.

Patta & patti

Narrow slit strip, edge-conditioned and re-coiled to the weight your press or roll-former actually runs.

Grade reference

Pick a grade. See where it belongs.

We supply the full 200, 300 and 400 series. These seven are the ones we're showing at Chennai — ferritics for exhaust and water-tank work, austenitics for food, chemical and coastal jobs.

409
Family
Ferritic · titanium stabilised
Chromium
10.5 – 11.7%
Known for
The most economical stainless. Good high-temperature oxidation resistance, weldable, magnetic.
Typically used in
Automotive exhaust systems, silencers, catalytic converter shells, agricultural equipment.
Worth knowing
Surface can bloom light rust in the open — specified where function, not appearance, is the point.

On the floor

The slitting line, running

A full-width coil entering the slitter and coming off the other side as separate strips, each one re-coiled to width. This is how patta and patti are made — and why we can break a big input coil into the small lots a single job actually needs.

Taloja service centre · 38 seconds
